_comment: Detail tiers and the metric sets of satk.style.profile / asset.check / style.card.
vanilla: the measured class band p10..p90 of the peer set. sa_plus: the same visual language with higher
budgets where silhouette and curvature live; its numbers are a PROPOSAL until validated next to vanilla in
previews and in game (every answer marks them 'proposal'). A metric without an sa_plus rule keeps the
vanilla band in both tiers (shading, UVs, scale, collision, lighting do not change with the tier).
Rule forms (values relative to the vanilla peer set): band [lo, hi] absolute; mul [a, b] x p50;
hi_mul x -> [p10, x * p90]; cap = hard upper limit shown next to the band. Rules are looked up by class
(car.sedan, then car), then by family (vehicle, map, ped, weapon, pickup, upgrade).

vanilla.what: every metric inside the class band p10..p90; for replacements that must sit unnoticed next to vanilla

sa_plus.what: default for new assets: vanilla style with higher budgets for silhouette and curvature

fence.what: A value is out of band (verdict low/high) only beyond the fence p10 - max(k*(p50 - p10), min_rel*|p50|) .. p90 + max(k*(p90 - p50), min_rel*|p50|) of the peer set; a peer set of fewer than borrow_below models also takes borrow x the margins of its parent (car.van -> car). Between the band and the fence a value is 'edge' (advisory, not counted). Calibrated by leave-one-out on vanilla (satk style build --validate).

notes.vehicle: sa_plus keeps the shared vehicle.txd textures, key colours and lamp codes, paint on vehiclegrunge256 with UV2 for the sheen, the shading rule, DXT1/DXT3 with one mip level, scale and proportions, frames and dummies, LOD and collision budgets. Own TXD: up to 4 textures, interior 256, wheel 128.
notes.map: sa_plus keeps tiling textures, prelight with warm nights, draw distance <= 300 for HD models with collision, and the vanilla LOD budget (not a ratio of the sa_plus HD). Round props 12-16 sides, poles 8. Texture side <= 512 (256 typical).
notes.ped: sa_plus: 1,600-2,500 triangles, 256x512 textures, the same 32-bone skeleton, one material.
notes.pickup: sa_plus: up to 2x the vanilla p90 triangles; 64-128 px textures.
notes.upgrade: sa_plus: up to 2x the vanilla p90 triangles; parts keep the vanilla frame names (ug_*).
